# StickySites

> Sticky notes for every website: a Manifest V3 Chrome extension in vanilla JavaScript with six note types, a floating icon cluster, a rich-text workspace panel and opt-in AES-256-GCM encryption.


## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Sticky notes for every website.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): StickySites is a Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) that injects a floating note workspace into every web page.
- [docs/COMPONENTS.md](docs/COMPONENTS.md): Background script running as an ES module.
- [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md): StickySites runs as a Chrome Extension on every web page.
- [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md): 1.
- [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): 1.
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) v4.1+ — fast, ESM-native test runner.
- [docs/known-issues.md](docs/known-issues.md): **Impact**: Low–Medium **Status**: Open
- [docs/requirements.md](docs/requirements.md): Project document
- [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md): New to StickySites?
- [docs/external-calls.md](docs/external-calls.md): StickySites makes no external network calls.
- [docs/integrations-and-assumptions.md](docs/integrations-and-assumptions.md): StickySites makes no external network calls — there are no third-party service integrations.
